jobs.title: Nutrition Content & Community Specialist (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über ENUSEN ENUSEN macht ausgewogene Ernährung im Alltag einfacher. Unser Ansatz Everyday Nutrition verbindet praktische Lösungen mit wissenschaftlich fundierter, verständlicher Kommunikation. Wir hören unseren Kundinnen und Kunden zu und entwickeln unsere Inhalte und Produkte mit ihrem Feedback weiter. Deine Mission Ernährungswissen verständlich machen, Vertrauen schaffen und eine aktive Community rund um ENUSEN aufbauen. Aufgaben Nutrition Content: Verständliche, wissenschaftlich fundierte Inhalte zu Ernährung und Alltag erstellen. Product Education: Zutaten, Nährwerte, Zubereitung und Anwendung unserer Produkte erklären. Website und Blog: Texte für Produktseiten, Landingpages und Blogartikel verfassen und aktualisieren. Community-Aufbau: Eine Community von Grund auf aufbauen, Mitglieder gewinnen und den Austausch aktiv gestalten. Community-Betreuung: Diskussionen moderieren sowie Ernährungs- und Produktfragen beantworten. Consumer Feedback: Kundenrückmeldungen auswerten und konkrete Verbesserungen anstoßen. Social Media: Beiträge, Videoskripte, Q&A-Formate und Creator-Briefings fachlich unterstützen. Qualifikation Das bringst du mit Studium der Ernährungswissenschaften, Ökotrophologie oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Erfahrung in Ernährungs- oder Produktkommunikation, idealerweise im Food- oder D2C-Umfeld. Schreibstärke und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen verständlich zu erklären. Interesse am Community-Aufbau und ein Gespür für Kundenbedürfnisse. Damit punktest du zusätzlich Erfahrung mit Social Media und digitalen Dialogformaten. Kenntnisse in Lebensmittelkommunikation und Freigabeprozessen. Erfahrung in der Auswertung von Kundenfeedback. jobs.title: Senior Developer Experience Writer
jobs.description: Our everyday digital experiences are in the middle of a realtime revolution: chatting alongside a livestream, getting realtime financial updates, or working with colleagues in a shared online space. Consumers now expect realtime as standard, and Ably powers a large part of it. We put developers first. Our products help teams build, extend, and deliver realtime digital experiences, delivering over 700 billion messages to more than 2 billion devices every month. Teams at HubSpot, Fin, Dialpad, NASCAR, Sportsbet, and General Motors all build on Ably. Working at Ably means helping build the infrastructure that will shape the next generation of the internet. More of what people do online is becoming live, shared and interactive, which only makes what we build more relevant and more necessary. AI is the latest place that shows up. There s still so much to build, and we d like your help with it. About this role Thousands of developers around the world use Ably s SDKs and APIs to power realtime features in their applications. The Developer Experience team is responsible for ensuring that Ably is a platform that exemplifies great developer experience, and is a reference point that other companies aspire to. As our Senior Developer Experience Writer, you’ll be contributing directly to this goal; helping developers to quickly understand Ably, build confidently and ultimately succeed with the platform. At its core, this is an AI-focussed role; you’ll be in charge of  setting up the foundations that empower engineers to produce first-class developer documentation with AI at scale. You’ll use AI to automate checks, maintain quality, and allow for rapid iteration in the content itself, as well as in the documentation platform. You’ll still be setting the standards for technical content across the business, and using your expertise to shape the information architecture. jobs.title: Freelance Writer
jobs.description: Our organization is seeking content writers to create articles and blog posts on a variety of topics. The rate of pay is $20 per 100 words (this comes out to approximately $100 per article or $50 per hour). Some topics you may be asked to write about include the following (you can always turn down a topic if you do not feel comfortable writing about it, however if you have experience or expertise in a specific area, please let us know): Health & beauty Fitness Home Decor Fashion Sports Do it yourself Finance Legal Medical Family/Parenting Relationships Real Estate Restaurants Contracting (plumbing, pool building, remodeling, etc.) These are just some of the more general industries and topics that we cover. Requirements : We ask that all work be completed using a word processor such as Microsoft Word or Open Office A reliable internet connection and the ability to meet deadlines Good communication skills and respond in a timely manner to editorial staff when they ask for updates on tasks, etc Work well as a team member with the rest of our content management and editorial staff Note : Applicants to this job signaled that accessing some writing tasks may require payment.

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.description: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.
